candidates.name: AsunaMasuda/Tokyo_Airbnb
candidates.what_it_holds: Three committed CSV files of Inside Airbnb Tokyo data covering Sep 2019-Aug 2020 (listings/calendar/reviews vintage, per README), plus an ipynb doing random-forest price prediction. Exact row counts not stated in README.
candidates.why_useful: Pre-2023 Inside Airbnb Tokyo vintage — our held Inside Airbnb panel only goes back to Dec 2022 and the 120-market Jun-2026 cohort is current-only. This is a genuine historical archive for a market we don't otherwise have pre-2023 for.

candidates.name: jacksonium/hongkongairbnb
candidates.what_it_holds: Six committed CSV files: Inside Airbnb calendar, listings, and reviews data for Hong Kong, snapshotted Nov 2019 and Nov 2020 (two full vintages).
candidates.why_useful: Pre-2023 Hong Kong Inside Airbnb vintage, a market and time window we don't currently hold; useful as a historical anchor for HK STR supply/pricing before regulation tightened.
candidates.size_hint: 6 CSV files across two snapshot dates

candidates.name: coletangsy/PowerBI-Airbnb-HK-market
candidates.what_it_holds: Inside Airbnb-sourced Hong Kong dataset committed as CSVs: listings-gz.csv (6,747 listings) and reviews.csv (203,701 reviews), plus an NLP-tokenized reviews file; vintage date not specified in README (likely single recent snapshot).

candidates.name: AceBee007/minpaku-reporter
candidates.what_it_holds: A Python (Poetry, pyenv, Selenium/Chromium webdriver) automation tool described as automating report work on minpaku.mlit.go.jp — Japan's official national minpaku (private lodging) registration and business-report portal run by MLIT. No committed data; it is a browser-automation client against the government's own STR reporting site, not airbnb.com.
candidates.why_useful: minpaku.mlit.go.jp is the authoritative Japanese government minpaku registration/business-days-reported system (the official counterpart to Tokyo/Kyoto minpaku registration counts). A tool that already knows how to interact with this specific official portal is a lead for automating a point-in-time pull of Japan's official minpaku registration/operating-days data, which is otherwise not on Inside Airbnb.
candidates.size_hint: small Python codebase, no data files

candidates.name: benstaydev/japan-stay-tax
candidates.what_it_holds: TypeScript/JS zero-dependency library with embedded accommodation-tax (宿泊税) rate tables for 50+ Japanese municipalities including Tokyo, Osaka, Kyoto, Niseko; exposes calculateTax()/searchAreas()/getArea() APIs; rates dated 'current as of June 2026' with a changelog tracking rate changes over time.
candidates.why_useful: A structured, versioned dataset of Japanese municipal lodging-tax rates and changes (a regulatory-cost input on STR/hotel unit economics in Japan, and a changelog that is quasi-point-in-time for rate changes) rather than free text.
candidates.time_coverage: current as of June 2026, with changelog

notes: gh search repos does not support boolean OR between quoted terms (a combined 'auckland OR sydney OR melbourne' query returned zero results while each term run alone returned hits) -- run one city per query. Sydney and Melbourne alone (run as part of the failed OR query) were not re-run individually due to the 6-call budget; a future scout should run 'sydney airbnb dataset' and 'melbourne airbnb' separately, and also try 'bangkok airbnb', 'singapore airbnb', and 'jnto japan tourism data' / 'korea tourism organization api' / 'STR ordinance tracker' which were not reached this pass. No repo found that mirrors official government minpaku registration COUNTS (only a scraper *tool* for the portal, AceBee007/minpaku-reporter, and a tax-rate library). Most city-name Airbnb repos are course/EDA projects re-running Inside Airbnb on a single undated snapshot with no distinguishing vintage -- these were excluded or rated low; only repos with an explicit pre-2023 vintage (Tokyo 2019-2020, HK Nov-2019/Nov-2020) were rated high. No APAC-specific regulation-tracker or STR-ordinance-database repos (Seoul minbak law, Bangkok condo/hotel-act enforcement, Bali visa/lodging tax, Singapore HDB short-let ban, HK Hotel and Guesthouse Accommodation Ordinance enforcement) surfaced in these queries; that remains an open gap worth a dedicated follow-up search with terms like 'guesthouse ordinance hong kong', 'sharing economy law korea dataset', 'STR ban singapore'.
